content:
**V.A.T.S.** or the **Vault-Tec Assisted Targeting System** is a statistic-based combat system in *Fallout 76*.

Due to the online multiplayer nature of the game, V.A.T.S. does not slow or stop time when activated, instead functioning as an aim assistant. The real-time V.A.T.S. system provides the unique advantage of being able to move around while using it. Opponents can also dodge the attack.

Actions cannot be queued and are instead taken immediately after selecting a target's body part and attacking it. V.A.T.S. actions use up Action Points like in previous iterations and cannot be used very frequently at early levels since all player characters start with 1 Agility. Players can make a critical strike on an opponent by pressing the button shown in the V.A.T.S. screen if the bar is full.

Note that certain Perks and Weapon Mods can influence either the factors or the direct chance to hit.

Using V.A.T.S. while wearing Power Armor causes a drain on the Fusion Core, with the drain rate being dependent on the AP cost of the weapon. A fresh Fusion Core at 100 condition is equivalent to 2,000 Action Points. [Ext 1]
